# dell — ServerOS device kit

- device: `device:llm-lab-dell` (linux, account `fjd`)
- role: company GPU compute and model deployment first; background work (production observation, shared-gateway changes, tests) while Windows is short of resources
- hub: `tokyo`

| layer | what this device gets |
|---|---|
| 1 core plugin | `hwz-server-os-linux-work` 3.1.0+srv0005.20261014a for claude-code, codex — skills serveros, runtime-management, ability-management, workspace-management, test-management; same payload runs serverosd |
| 2 ability family | `dell-gpu-compute` from ProfessorZhi/ability-management, one pinned revision, read back after rollout |
| 3 monitor · secrets_sync | key center: pull ProfessorZhi/serveros-secrets, decrypt this device's bundles (SOPS + age) into 0600 env files, restart what reads them |
| 3 monitor · serverosd | basic: resources, anomalies, runtime status (python daemon) |
| 3 monitor · core_lite | native: C++ collector → status.json (0600) every 30 s, observe only |
| 3 monitor · node_connector | link: reports this device to the hub (tokyo) |

## Configuration outside this repository

These live in local binding files, not in git. Re-apply them after a reinstall.

- hub binding (`tokyo`): `device:llm-lab-dell|claude-fjd  with  account: fjd`
- this device's connector binding: `runtime: claude-fjd`

## Install

```bash
cd ~/src/serveros && git pull
REV=$(git -C ../ability-management rev-parse origin/main)
python3 distribution/device_kit.py plan    --device dell --ability-rev $REV
python3 distribution/device_kit.py install --device dell --ability-rev $REV --apply
python3 distribution/device_kit.py install --device dell --ability-rev $REV --apply --enable   # also enables the units
```

## Update in place

```bash
python3 distribution/device_kit.py update   --device dell --data-root $DATA_ROOT            # dry run
python3 distribution/device_kit.py update   --device dell --data-root $DATA_ROOT --apply
python3 distribution/device_kit.py versions --device dell
```

Rollback: rerun `install` with the previous `--ability-rev`; `scripts/release.py rollback` for the node runtime; `systemctl --user disable --now <unit>` for a monitor unit.
